changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ChangeLog') BEGIN create table dbo.ChangeLog ( Id bigint identity not null, AssetTypeId int sparse, IntersectTypeId int sparse, PredicateId int sparse, AssetId bigint sparse, GroupId int sparse, ResourceId int sparse, TagId int sparse, ChangedBy int not null, ChangedOn datetime constraint DF_ChangeLog_ChangedOn default(getutcdate()) not null, ChangeObject int not null, ChangeAction int not null, [Changes] json not null, [Version] int not null, constraint [PK_ChangeLog] primary key clustered ( Id asc ) ); END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ChangeLog_Asset') BEGIN create index IX_ChangeLog_Asset on dbo.ChangeLog ( AssetId ) include (ChangedOn, [Version]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ChangeLog_AssetType') BEGIN create index IX_ChangeLog_AssetType on dbo.ChangeLog ( AssetTypeId ) include (ChangedOn, [Version]) END
